task.instructions:
Using matplotlib, read commute.csv (columns: state, minutes) and draw a horizontal Cleveland dot plot of the average commute time for each of the 40 states.
Requirements:
- One circular dot per state, sorted so the state with the LONGEST commute is at the TOP and the shortest at the bottom.
- Show every state name as a y tick label (all 40 must be visible).
- Draw a vertical red dashed line at the median of the 40 values.
- Set the x axis limits to 0..45 and label the x axis 'Average commute (minutes)'.
- Set the title to exactly 'Average commute by state'.
- Make the figure 8 by 11 inches.
- Save the figure at 100 dpi.
Save the figure as figure.png.

function.arguments:
{"command": "cat <<'EOF' > create_plot.py
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Read the CSV file
df = pd.read_csv('commute.csv')

# Sort by commute time (descending - longest at top)
df_sorted = df.sort_values('minutes', ascending=False)

# Calculate median
median = df_sorted['minutes'].median()

# Create figure
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 11))

# Create horizontal dot plot
# y positions: 0 to 39 (one for each state)
y_positions = range(len(df_sorted))

# Plot dots
ax.scatter(df_sorted['minutes'], y_positions, s=100, c='black', edgecolors='black', zorder=3)

# Set y tick labels to state names
ax.set_yticks(y_positions)
ax.set_yticklabels(df_sorted['state'])

# Set x axis limits and label
ax.set_xlim(0, 45)
ax.set_xlabel('Average commute (minutes)')

# Set title
ax.set_title('Average commute by state')

# Add vertical red dashed line at median
ax.axvline(x=median, color='red', linestyle='--', linewidth=1.5)

# Set figure dpi
fig.savefig('figure.png', dpi=100, bbox_inches='tight')

print(f"Median commute time: {median:.1f} minutes")
print("Figure saved as figure.png")
EOF
"}
